items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states a variant of the derived projection formula, identifying F^bullet tensor^L_O Lf^*G^bullet with F^bullet tensor^L over f^{-1}O' of f^{-1}G^bullet (statement lines 3727-3743). The proof is short and proceeds by unfolding definitions: for modules the identity F tensor_O f^*G = F tensor over f^{-1}O' of f^{-1}G follows from the definition of f^*G as O tensor over f^{-1}O' of f^{-1}G together with associativity of the tensor product (proof lines 3746-3752), and the author records that the case of complexes follows from this and the definitions of the derived tensor product (proof lines 3752-3754). The content is the correct unfolding, which is why the argument is one line. The claim is H2: a definitional identification, with the passage to complexes stated as following from the definitions.
